gpt-6-luna.rate_source: Recorded study rates; paper.tex and saved run configurations

cost_definition: Saved token consumption re-priced at recorded standard uncached study rates. All received generation attempts for a cell are charged; grader/annotation costs and human time excluded. These are not reconciled invoices or current-price quotes.
sample_definition: MIT: 30 primary blocks, all 10 models and three conditions. AP: 22 long questions, all seven models and three conditions, retaining four Nano partial cells. The extra MIT source-ambiguity block is retained in question-level JSON but excluded from primary summaries.
uncertainty: 5000 paired question bootstrap draws, same question resample for every model and condition within each dataset. These describe question-level uncertainty conditional on the saved deterministic outputs. Frontier inclusion frequencies are not significance tests or probabilities of population optimality.
